key_rationale: With core inflation at 3.10%, the real policy rate is becoming excessively restrictive, threatening to stifle the 6.80% GVA growth momentum. A shift to a neutral stance and a 25 bps reduction is necessary to prevent the policy rate from becoming a drag on the economy, as the headline CPI of 4.75% is driven largely by food price volatility rather than generalized demand-pull pressures.
